items.problem: Bootstrap omitted linked shared source and assets.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap used directory recursion instead of the UWP project's declared item graph. Tier 1 is feasible and stronger than prose because the script can materialize linked items before the agent sees the mapping.
items.change: Resolve project properties including GetDirectoryNameOfFileAbove, copy external linked source/resource/asset items to Link destinations, reject unresolved links, and include them in existing rewrite/triage/mapping stages.
items.expected_effect: Shared app shells, pages, dictionaries, helpers, and assets appear in the initial migration mapping and no longer require manual reconstruction.
items.falsifiable_check: Rerunning bootstrap on MobileBroadband reports 29 files with 13 linked items, and the target contains mapped App.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml, Styles\Styles.xaml, and Assets\windows-sdk.png.

items.problem: Zero-defer migrations always produced a false validator warning.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap and validator used different empty-list sentinels. Tier 1 is the highest reliable fix because changing the producer removes the warning without agent judgement.
items.change: Emit the validator's canonical 'No items deferred.' text when no rows are deferred.
items.expected_effect: The deferred consistency gate reports PASS rather than WARN for zero-defer projects.
items.falsifiable_check: A fresh zero-defer bootstrap produces MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md containing 'No items deferred.' and validator section 4 prints its no-defer PASS line.

items.problem: Desktop scaffold title and initial viewport leaked into the migrated shell.
items.root_cause: The skill specified navigation fidelity but not host-window fidelity. Existing tooling already routes explicit resize APIs; when no explicit size exists, title and minimum usable geometry require source-layout judgement that a generic Tier 1/2 transform cannot safely infer.
items.change: Add shell fidelity invariants for Window/AppWindow title and explicit or minimum non-clipping initial client geometry.
items.expected_effect: Migrated apps do not ship generic scaffold branding or open with content clipped by a smaller desktop default.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the desktop title is 'MobileBroadband' rather than 'WinUI Desktop', and the initial client viewport exposes at least the source shell's 800x600 usable area.
